limitations: All observed native modes/log masses are retained; the task cut product is not an exact joint Bayesian posterior after reusing the same image in the body update.

The root task law preserves the forward core pose mean. Existing direction-dependent S2 approximation can leave first-order inverse-query position mean residuals; these are measured, not zeroed or mislabelled second order.

Physical reaching is evaluated at the unchanged 6mm requirement; each final reached/collided flag and actual distance is reported separately. Body absolute pose overconfidence is not claimed resolved, and no paired reach improvement is claimed.
The actual 20Hz physical and 15fps camera cadence is not a hard real-time guarantee. Observations are archived at capture, but only explicitly selected latest captures are fused.
New body/goal absolute error, observed-relative closure error, physical reach distance, and covariance width have different meanings and are reported separately.
Old source update and 10cm-class relative discrepancy evidence are historical diagnostics, not verification of new source or paired motion performance.
